correctness.rationale: With beta=r/(1+r), gamma=(1-r)/(1+r), the left and right recurrence matrices have nonnegative coefficients if 0<=r<=1; forward and reverse induction then prove P_n=RL>=0 for every n. For n>=2, apply the two sweeps to e1: after left sweep v_j=beta^(j-1)gamma. The final component after right sweep is w_n=beta v_(n-1)+gamma v_n=beta^(n-1)gamma(1+gamma)=2r^(n-1)(1-r)/(1+r)^(n+1), strictly negative for r>1. At n=1 the product is gamma^2≥0 for all r>=0. For n=2,r=2 the entry is -4/27, a sharp minimal witness. Independently implemented both sweeps with rational fractions and checked the exact corner for n=2..9 at r=1/2,1,6/5,2,9/2; these bounded checks corroborate, not establish, the full all-n proof. Precisely full-step historical alternation, uniform 1D grid, Dirichlet zeros and constant D.
